title: New hire can't access the ERP invoicing module
description: They need to get into the ERP for payroll, but they can't see the 'invoicing' menu. The other modules are fine.

worklogs.description: Checked the user's ERP role assignment; the invoicing module was missing.
ERP-Admin > Authorized Modules > 'Invoicing' was added and the cache was refreshed.

comments.author: agent
comments.message: The invoicing module permission has been assigned; it will appear in your menu within 5 minutes.

comments.author: customer
comments.message: I can see it, the authorization was successful. Thanks.

resolutionNote: The 'Invoicing' module permission was assigned to the user. The ERP cache refreshed within 5 minutes.

csat.comment: My issue was resolved very quickly.
